description: This file contains utility classes and functions related to Topaz models within the larger codebase. It defines custom exceptions, model information handling, environment validation, and API configuration methods for the Topaz image processing API.

classes.name: TopazException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Topaz-related errors, inherits from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: TopazModelInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates methods for validating environment, retrieving models, and managing API credentials specific to Topaz.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates that the environment has the necessary API key for Topaz integration.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Returns a list of available Topaz model identifiers.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key, either from parameter or secret manager.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, either from parameter, secret manager, or default.

methods.name: str get_base_model(model: str)
methods.description: Returns the base model name given a model string.
